children: On Friday,
Elon Musk
said
Eli Lilly
has "some banger drugs coming out”, after the drugmaker’s CEO
Dave Ricks
took on a “bet” responding to venture investor
Vinod Khosla
on X.
Ricks Answers Big Biotech Skeptics
Ricks’ reply came after Khosla commented on Musk’s post, which shared a thread by biotech enthusiast
Mgoes
about potential breakthroughs in human biology.
“Agree 100% but unlikely it will come from the big bio companies,” said Khosla. To which Ricks replied, “I’ll take that bet.”
Eli Lilly has some banger drugs coming out!
Khosla’s post followed Musk’s earlier comment that breakthroughs "in everything are accelerating exponentially." Musk added that an exponential "always starts off looking small."
Neither Musk nor Ricks named specific drugs.
If you look closely enough, breakthroughs in everything are accelerating exponentially.
An exponential always starts off looking small.
Viral Biotech Thread Sparked the Exchange
The exchange began with a post earlier this week by X user "Mgoes," who said a massive shift is underway in human biology. He said he does not work at Lilly,
Novo Nordisk A/S
or other large drugmakers.

He cited recent results, including Lilly’s retatrutide reached about 28% weight loss in a Phase 3 trial; a once-daily pill roughly doubled median survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer, 13.2 months versus 6.6; and a personalized mRNA vaccine beat
Merck & Co.
’s
Keytruda alone in a 1,137-patient melanoma Phase 3.
